description: This file contains definitions of various graphics state structures, classes, and utility functions used in the ANGLE project, specifically related to rendering states such as RasterizerState, BlendState, DepthStencilState, and SamplerState, along with geometric and buffer management utilities.

classes.name: RasterizerState
classes.description: Represents rasterization state settings such as culling, front face, and polygon offset.

classes.name: BlendState
classes.description: Represents blending state settings including blend factors, equations, and color masks.

classes.name: DepthStencilState
classes.description: Represents depth and stencil testing configurations.

classes.name: SamplerState
classes.description: Encapsulates sampler parameters like filtering, wrapping, anisotropy, and comparison modes.

classes.name: ImageUnit
classes.description: Represents an image unit for shader image load/store operations.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: Defines a rectangle with utility functions for flipping, removing reversal, and intersection.

classes.name: Box
classes.description: Defines a 3D box with comparison operators and conversion to Rectangle.

classes.name: Offset
classes.description: Represents a 3D offset with comparison operators.

classes.name: Extents
classes.description: Represents dimensions in 3D space with comparison operators.

methods.name: RasterizerState()
methods.description: Constructor initializing rasterizer state with default values.

methods.name: BlendState()
methods.description: Constructor initializing blend state with default values.

methods.name: allChannelsMasked()
methods.description: Checks if all color channels are masked.

methods.name: DepthStencilState()
methods.description: Constructor initializing depth-stencil state with default values.

methods.name: SamplerState()
methods.description: Constructor initializing sampler state with default values.

methods.name: CreateDefaultForTarget(TextureType)
methods.description: Creates a default sampler state based on texture type.

methods.name: setWrapS(GLenum)
methods.description: Sets wrap mode for S coordinate.

methods.name: setWrapT(GLenum)
methods.description: Sets wrap mode for T coordinate.

methods.name: setWrapR(GLenum)
methods.description: Sets wrap mode for R coordinate.

methods.name: updateWrapTCompareMode()
methods.description: Updates internal wrapT compare mode flags.

methods.name: MinMax(int, int, int*, int*)
methods.description: Utility function to determine min and max of two integers.

methods.name: Rectangle::flip(bool, bool) const
methods.description: Returns a flipped version of the rectangle.

methods.name: Rectangle::encloses(const gl::Rectangle&) const
methods.description: Checks if this rectangle encloses another.

methods.name: Rectangle::toRect() const
methods.description: Converts a Box to a Rectangle.

methods.name: ValidateComponentTypeMasks(unsigned long, unsigned long, unsigned long, unsigned long)
methods.description: Validates component type masks for draw buffers and attributes.

methods.name: GetBoundBufferAvailableSize(const OffsetBindingPointer<Buffer>&)
methods.description: Returns available size of a bound buffer.
